D: An 11-year-old in rural New Zealand finally meets the dad he's been bigging up his whole life.
P: Serve the mains when Alamein rolls back into town.
S: Paraoa parai: a soft yeasted dough cut into squares and fried until puffed and golden, with butter and golden syrup.

Creamed and whole corn kernels in a light batter with spring onion, fried in spoonfuls until golden, with sweet chilli sauce. Mix 420g creamed corn, 200g corn kernels, 150g self-raising flour, 2 eggs and 3 sliced spring onions. Fry heaped tablespoons in oil for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain and serve hot with 125ml sweet chilli sauce.
Fish shop hot chips with garlic aioli
the fish and chip shop down the road from Waihau Bay

Thick-cut chips fried twice until crunchy outside and fluffy inside, salted hot, wrapped in paper with a garlicky aioli and tomato sauce. Cut 1.2kg floury potatoes into 1.5cm chips, soak in cold water for 30 minutes and pat dry. Heat oil to 150C and fry in batches for 6 minutes until soft but pale. Drain and rest 15 minutes. Heat the oil to 190C and fry again for 3 minutes until golden and crunchy. Salt straight away. Mix 150g mayo with 2 crushed garlic cloves and a squeeze of lemon. Serve in paper with the aioli and tomato sauce.
M: Alamein, who'd rather be called Shogun

Pork shoulder, kūmara, pumpkin and cabbage wrapped in foil and cabbage leaves, slow roasted at 160C for four hours until falling apart. Season 1.2kg pork shoulder well. Line a deep roasting tin with cabbage leaves, add the pork, 600g kūmara, 600g pumpkin and 400g potatoes in chunks, then cover with more cabbage and wrap tightly in foil. Roast at 160C for 4 hours until the pork falls apart.
Nan's savoury mince on buttered toast
what's in the pot at Nan's house

Beef mince simmered with onion, carrot, peas and a rich gravy until thick, spooned over thick buttered toast with grated tasty cheese on top. Brown 600g beef mince in a large pan, breaking it up. Add 1 diced onion and 1 grated carrot and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 400ml beef stock. Simmer 15 minutes until thick, adding 150g frozen peas for the last 5. Toast 8 thick slices of white bread and butter well. Spoon the mince over and top with 80g grated tasty cheese.
W: Vanilla ice cream folded with crushed honeycomb toffee made from sugar, golden syrup and bicarb.
K: A thick lime milkshake, the way the corner dairy makes them. Blend 600ml cold milk with 4 scoops vanilla ice cream and 4 tbsp lime cordial until frothy. Pour into 4 tall glasses and serve straight away with straws.

s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp salt with 325ml warm water into a soft dough. Prove 1 hour, roll 2cm thick and cut into 12 squares. Fry at 175C for 2 minutes a side until puffed and golden. Serve warm with 60g butter and golden syrup.

w.how: Heat 100g sugar and 2 tbsp golden syrup until bubbling and golden, about 4 minutes. Take off the heat, whisk in 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda and pour onto baking paper to set. Smash into small pieces and fold through 1L slightly softened vanilla ice cream, then refreeze 1 hour.
